title: Spatial Frame Lab · v0.9.6
changes: Hold the left thumbstick to open a tiny horizontal experiment selector near the controller; tilt left or right and release to activate the selected mode.
Select Frames, Five Strings, Two Thumbs or Off from a unified menu; no additional permanent XR toolbar.
Join the left and right index fingertips and thumb tips, spread the hands into a rectangular outline and hold to leave the frame suspended in space.
Choose a 1.5, 3 or 5-second frame-detach interval under XR Personalization; completed frames remain while exploring other modes.
Keep all drawing, tracking, geometry and musical-string effects entirely local, with no external inference or billing.
Added local tests for left-thumbstick selection, frame geometry, timed release and spatial retention. Existing watcher remains unchanged.
